notes: The supplied text (catalog page 899) holds only course descriptions for PSTC courses, under the page footer 'Programs of Study – Regional Public Safety Training Center'. It does not include the program section for the POST Basic Law Enforcement Academy - Modular Format certificate: no requirements list, no total units, no outcomes and no careers. Check the program page, likely on an adjacent page of the PDF.

The course descriptions give unit ranges: PSTC 1502 is 6-7 units, PSTC 1503 is 8-11 units and PSTC 1504 is 13.5-17 units. They describe a three-part series: 1502, then 1503, then 1504. Because the program requirements are not printed, these courses were not placed in blocks.
Career wording ('entry-level employment as reserve or regular full-time California peace officers') appears only in course descriptions, so it was not recorded as a program career.
PSTC 1505 (California Highway Patrol Basic Law Enforcement Academy) appears in the text but is not on the closed list. It belongs to a different program and was not recorded.
